Most LinkedIn advice comes from people who built their audience in 2019. The algorithm has changed. The competition has changed. What worked then won't work now.

I run a LinkedIn content agency. We've built personal brands for founders, executives, and B2B companies - some with massive logos, others starting from scratch.

This is the exact LinkedIn growth strategy I'd follow if I had to start over today.

IN THIS VIDEO YOU'LL LEARN:
 How to research your niche before posting anything
 LinkedIn profile optimization that converts (headline, banner, about section, featured section)
 The 4-part content funnel: Growth  Authority  Conversion  Personal
 Where LinkedIn content actually comes from (hint: you don't "create" it)
 The LinkedIn commenting strategy nobody talks about
 How to find your point of view that makes people follow YOU
 LinkedIn posting schedule and best times to post in 2026
 What NOT to do on LinkedIn

KEY TAKEAWAYS:
 Spend 72 hours consuming before you post: study 20-30 creators in your space
 Your LinkedIn profile is a landing page, not a resume
 Comments matter more than posts when you're starting out
 5 posts/week, Monday-Friday, 7-9am Eastern works best for B2B
 Your POV is your moat: find what you believe that others won't say
